about: Recipes scripts/skills-eval/replay_fixtures.py replays against the eval instance before the evals run: it writes each image at its path in the instance's Agent folder, runs each fixture's calls in order as tools/call (each must succeed), and records the sha256 of every file a fixture leaves behind, so expectations can check what the agent must not change.

fixtures.description: promo-draft.comp in the Agent folder: a 1080x1080 navy canvas with a Badge image layer, a Headline text layer, a top-level Logo and a second Logo inside the position-locked folder Footer; plus exports/promo-draft.png, a teammate's earlier export. The document is closed afterwards.

calls.note: added while the folder is active, so it lands inside Footer; the next call makes sure
